comment: HTTP 429 carrying Retry-After as a plain count of seconds (Req 23.8) -- the first of the two forms the header may take. The metrics collector must wait exactly the duration this header specifies, honouring it rather than applying any locally chosen backoff; metrics_batch_429_retry_after_http_date.json is the sibling recording the other legal form (an HTTP-date), which must be honoured identically after being parsed to a duration rather than treated as unparseable.
